answer: tools/plugin/jsonl_log.py writes one JSON object per line. Each record requires error_code, unit_id, and ts. Values (not keys) are control-stripped then secret-redacted before write, so a planted synthetic ghp_ canary is grepped absent while the record (unit_id, error_code, ts, correlation id) remains. Rotation is bounded by max_bytes and max_files; OS file count and sizes stay inside those caps. Control-character injection cannot forge a JSONL boundary. SUCCESS:IMP-0056

evidence.claim: A planted synthetic credential is grepped absent from the JSONL sink while the same file still contains the record that referenced it (correlation id, unit_id, error_code, ts).

probes.raw_output: SUCCESS:test_log_redaction secret body grepped absent; record kept
signal1: grep secret body exit 1 (no match); signal2: record kept

evidence.claim: After many writes, OS file count is <= max_files and every file size is <= max_bytes. A generation past max_files does not exist.

probes.raw_output: SUCCESS:test_log_rotation size and count bounds hold

probes.command: stat file count and sizes vs declared caps

negative_controls.description: Disable the redaction filter and assert GNU grep -F DOES find the planted body, proving the grep detector is not a no-op.
Inject LF, CR, NEL (U+0085), LS (U+2028), PS (U+2029) and a forged JSON object into a field. The sink must remain one json.loads-able line; error_code FORGED must not appear as a sibling record.

question: Implement JSON-lines logging where every record carries the error code, unit id and timestamp, where a redaction filter runs on the value side of every field before write, and where files rotate by size and count so logs cannot consume the disk.

residual_unknowns.claim: IMP-0051 taxonomy codes are not on this worktree; the logger accepts caller-supplied error_code strings rather than importing a missing taxonomy module.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Join logger.error_code against IMP-0051 once that unit is delivered.

reviewer.notes: Probe 2 injects record-boundary controls and a forged JSON object, then counts json.loads lines on the bytes (not the logger return value). One record. FORGED not accepted. Rotation caps checked via os.stat. Negative-control grep fires with redact=False.

secret_policy: No real credential was read, printed, rotated, or written. Tests plant a synthetic ghp_ canary; receipts and this document do not contain that body.
title: Structured logging with mandatory redaction and bounded rotation
